UC Berkeley experts argue that AI progress does not require ever-larger data centers.
Smaller open-source models are becoming capable enough for many tasks while using far less compute, energy, and water — and increasingly they could run on local HW.
Data-center network fabrics are undergoing another architectural shift as optical interconnects assume a larger role in AI-cluster connectivity.
The push toward 1-megawatt racks is forcing fundamental changes in data center architecture, including cooling, power delivery, rack design, and 3D-IC packaging.

posts.title: Li Auto's chip ambitions extend from assisted driving to data centers, report says
posts.summary:
Li Auto is exploring an in-house cloud inference chip, and the project is still at an early stage.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Li Auto is in the early stages of developing an in-house cloud inference chip to handle workloads currently managed by GPUs.
The project aims to leverage the dataflow architecture used in the company's vehicle-side assisted driving chips to achieve cost efficiencies.
By reusing compute designs and software tools from its vehicle NPU, Li Auto seeks to optimize R&D spending while addressing cloud-specific requirements like dynamic batching and cluster scheduling.
The initiative highlights a broader trend of automotive companies moving vertically into specialized silicon to manage the high costs of AI model training and inference.

posts.title: Li Auto's L6 tops 400,000 cumulative deliveries as revamped model revives demand
posts.summary:
The Li L6 delivered about 9,000 units in the first half of August, compared with just 2,716 for the whole of July, based on CnEVPost-compiled data.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Cumulative deliveries of the Li L6 SUV have surpassed 400,000 units, with the model reaching this milestone in less than 27 months.
Demand has rebounded significantly following the July 16 launch of a revamped model, with approximately 9,000 units delivered in the first half of August compared to 2,716 for all of July.
The new L6 features upgraded specifications, including a 51 kWh battery for 300 km of all-electric range and the integration of Li Auto's in-house Mach M100 assisted driving chip.
As the company's entry-level model, the L6 remains a critical volume driver, having accounted for 41% of Li Auto's total deliveries in 2025.

posts.title: Geely Farizon's first overseas plant starts operations in Indonesia
posts.summary:
The first locally assembled V8E all-electric logistics vehicle rolled off the line on August 13 at a plant about 80 kilometers southeast of Jakarta.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Geely Farizon has commenced operations at its first overseas knock-down (KD) plant in Indonesia, located southeast of Jakarta.
The facility has begun assembly of the V8E all-electric logistics vehicle, which is specifically calibrated for local road conditions and tropical climates.
This localized production strategy is designed to bypass import tariffs, streamline supply chains, and reduce operating costs in the competitive Southeast Asian market.
